problems: Cliopatria's 'Hamdanid Emirates' (936-1259) is not one state: shapes 1028-1259 (16) are mislabelled and were marked wrong with empty corrections, so the --resolve run shows 16 'region resolves to no cells' warnings by design; the Cliopatria data fixer should relabel them.
The 947-979 Hamdanid shapes carry about 120,000 km2 of Iranian and Caucasian cells (East and West Azerbaijan, Nakhchivan, Karabakh, Derbent) that no page supports; corrected away.

abbasid-caliphate-buyid-dynasty is written as an umbrella stand-in: the slash row is the Buyid state's own 947-969 land, which buyid-dynasty (me-08-c) already adopts as keyframe buyid-dynasty_947; draw it once. Q12536 looks wrong for both Buyid rows.
Hamdanid start is 929 (the Abbasid dossier's vassal_start year), not the infobox's 890; end 1004 (infobox) although other pages say 1015/6 or 1017.

WebFetch returns a small model's extract, not the raw page: the 'quotes' in notes are from those extracts and may be close paraphrases; the Sa'd al-Dawla URL is a disambiguation page (listed in sources with that note) and the Sa'd al-Dawla of Aleppo page was used instead; the Emirate of Aleppo page was thin.
Pages: 14 distinct (Hamdanid 9 content pages plus the disambiguation; Ziyarid 2, refetched once for its rulers table; Abbasid/Buyid 2); the Buyid dynasty page is shared by all three dossiers.

Counterpart strings used that are not slugs of any dossier: 'Asfar ibn Shiruya', 'Makan ibn Kaki'; slugs that will need a dossier: nizari-ismaili-state, zaydi-alid-dynasties (exists as a Cliopatria row), mirdasid-dynasty, uqaylid-dynasty, marwanids-of-diyar-bakr (exist).
